HOW TO APPLY TO
Durban University of Technology (DUT)
Ignite your creativity
Forge a distinctive future
Important Notes:

• Meeting the minimum entry requirements for your programme of choice,
does not guarantee acceptance.
• Submission of a completed application does not guarantee selection/
admission, or that you may register.
• Y our application is evaluated by the university. Should your evaluation
outcome be positive, you will receive a notification from CAO and
Acceptance package/ communication directly from the university.
• If you have indicated in your application that you require residence, you
will also receive correspondence from Housing Department once the
outcome of your application is finalised and positive.
• Applicants who have studied at DUT/other University must apply using
the following link Online Applications (dut.ac.za)
INTERNATIONAL SECONDARY
SCHOOL RESULTS
If you have an international secondary school results or IEB/ICGSE, you will need to have your
statement of results evaluated to ensure equivalence to the National Senior Certificate. This means
your international secondary school results must be evaluated by either the South African Qualification

Authority (SAQA) for Diploma or Universities South Africa (USAf) for Degree Courses
For SAQA application and queries, visit www.saqa.org.za.
For USAf Matriculation Board Evaluation application and queries, visit http://mb.usaf.ac.za.
International applicants are required to check the International Brochure for detailed information on the
admission process: International Education and Partnerships (IEP) (dut.ac.za)
APPLICATION PROCESS FOR NSFAS
Y ou can apply online using a smart phone, tablet or computer by following these simple steps:
After you click on ‘submit’, your application reference number will appear on the screen. The reference number will also be
sent to the cellphone number and email address you provided.
Please note that your application for funding is not guaranteed and subject to NSFAS T erms and Condition.

THE MINIMUM ENTRANCE REQUIREMENTS
FOR ADMISSION TO DUT
South African Matric/ Grade 12
HIGHER EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS SUB-FRAMEWORK (HEQSF)

Higher Certificate Diploma Bachelor’s Degree:
A National Senior Certificate (NSC) as
certified by the Council for General and
Further Education and Training (Umalusi),
with a minimum achievement rating of 3
for English.
a National Senior Certificate (NSC) as
certified by the Council for General and
Further Education and Training (Umalusi),
with a minimum of achievement rating of
3 for English and a minimum achievement
rating of 3 in four recognised NSC 20-credit
subjects.
a National Senior Certificate (NSC) as certified
by the Council for General and Further
Education and Training (Umalusi), with a
minimum achievement rating of 3 for English
and a minimum achievement rating of 4 in four
NSC 20-credit subjects chosen from the NSC
designated subject list.

Higher Certificate: Diploma: Bachelor’s Degree:
A National Certificate (Vocational) Level
four with at least 50% in English.
A National Certificate (Vocational) Level four

with the following minimum requirements:
At least 50% in three fundamental subjects
including, English; and
At least 60% in three compulsory vocational
subjects.
A National Certificate (Vocational) Level four

with the following minimum requirements:
At least 60% in three fundamental subjects,
including English; and
At least 70% in four compulsory vocational
subjects, chosen from the National Certificate
(Vocational) Level four subjects.

INSTRUCTIONS BELOW:
FIRST -TIME UNDERGRADUATE APPLICANTS
Identify the course you wish to study.
DUT Programmes can be found in the 2026 Career
leaflets and Study Opportunities. CLICK HERE
New applications for applicants who are
applying into a university for the FIRST
TIME must be completed through the Central
Application Office (CAO) online platform ( https://
www.cao.ac.za/ ) before the closing date.
The application must reach the CAO office before
the closing date of 30 September 2025
(Please refer to specific programmes for relevant
closing dates, as some programmes close earlier than
30 September 2025).
Make sure that your application AND fee
reach the CAO before the closing date.
Kindly consult the CAO webpage at www.cao.ac.za
for any changes or update on your application.
Have your mobile phone and an active
email address ready, as you require both to
access and complete the online application.
When completing online application please ensure
that you attach/upload certified copies of
your identity document and Final Grade
11 & Grade 12 certificate (June/ Trial report
if you have not written your final examination).
Pay application fee of R250 (SA Citizen)
or R300 (International applicants) when
submitting your application.
Y our application will only be active once payment
is received.
Applicants will be notified via email/
SMS, of the outcome of their application.
